title: Visiting a protected page while signed out redirects to the sign-in page
expected: / redirects to /login with the sign-in form
actual: http://localhost:5176/ -> /login, form 'Welcome back' with username/password and Sign In
evidence: Browser tab URL after navigate: http://localhost:5176/login

title: Sign-in with empty fields
expected: Inline message asking for username and password; no request succeeds
actual: Message 'Enter your username and password.' shown, stays on /login
evidence: get_page_text on /login after clicking Sign In

title: Sign-in with a wrong password
expected: Message 'Invalid username or password.', stays on /login
actual: As expected (qa-ft-ops / wrong password, 1 failure on a fixture account)
evidence: get_page_text: 'Invalid username or password.'; console: one 401 on POST /api/v1/auth/login (expected)

title: Sign-in as Administrator lands on Tank & Stock Dashboard with Bekasi data
expected: Redirect to /, KPIs, commodity cards and tank table for Bekasi 20 Oct 2026; no console errors
actual: 29.4% utilisation, 23/5 active vs empty, 4 critical alerts, 7 commodity cards, tank table T.01..; no JS errors
evidence: get_page_text on /; read_console_messages onlyErrors: only the expected 401s from the pre-login session check and the wrong-password attempt

title: Deep link is restored after sign-in
expected: Signed out, open /management -> /login; after signing in, land on /management
actual: After sign-in (qa-ft-ops) the app lands on / (Tank & Stock Dashboard); the requested page is lost
evidence: navigate /management (signed out) -> /login; Sign In -> URL http://localhost:5176/ . RequireAuth stores state.from (guards.tsx:15) but LoginPage always <Navigate to="/"> (LoginPage.tsx:68)

title: Commodity card dialog (CPO)
expected: Clicking the CPO card opens a dialog with quantity chart, average quality in period, and the tanks in this stock; Escape closes it
actual: Dialog 'CPO - Quantity', 7 of 7 tanks, Average 4,889.165 t / Max 7,044.154 t, 'Average quality in period FFA 3.915 M&I 0.387 IV 52.18 DOBI 2.64 Carotene 544', chart 21/9..20/10, tank table for 20 Oct 2026 (T.11 887.992 t, T.12 2,250.584 t ...); Escape closed it
evidence: screenshot during test (not kept, PASS); find 'CPO - Quantity' after Escape -> no match

title: Commodity Stock Movement section on Tank & Stock
expected: Section shows the last 30 days; the latest All-commodities figure equals the current total; choosing a commodity switches the chart
actual: 21 Sept – 20 Oct 2026; All commodities 6,594.507 -> 7,289.816 t (+695.310, +10.5%), equals Stock Overview 7,290 t and API /portfolio/stock 7,289,816 kg; 'Show CPO on the chart' switched to 'CPO +1,743.331 t (+39.7%)'
evidence: get_page_text on /; click ref 'Show CPO on the chart'

title: Day picker loads an earlier day
expected: Choosing 15 Oct 2026 reloads KPIs and cards for that day
actual: Header 15 Oct 2026, 33.8% utilisation, 24/4 tanks, critical alerts T.04, T.05, T.15, CPO 6,077 / 11,340 t
evidence: get_page_text after picking '15 Oct 2026. Day with logsheet data'

title: Stock Overview renders totals and movement
expected: Stock, capacity, fill, tanks reporting, attention list, By site table and Commodity Stock Movement agree with the API
actual: Stock 7,290 t (+1,512 t vs yesterday), Capacity 24,780 t, Fill 29.7%, 23/26 reporting, Free 17,220 t; Bekasi movement 6,595 -> 7,290 t (+695, +10.5%) with largest moves CPO +1,743 t, Refined −1,070 t, PFAD +250 t
evidence: get_page_text on /management (the KPI count-up animation shows 0 t for ~1 s while the tab is in the background, then the real figures)

title: Stock Overview: By commodity view
expected: Tab switches to per-commodity rows and the URL keeps the view
actual: URL /management?view=commodity; rows CPO 6,129/11,340 t, Refined 861/11,020 t, PFAD 300/460 t, SLUDGE 0/270 t, Other 0/1,690 t
evidence: get_page_text after clicking 'By commodity'

title: Per-commodity figures agree between Tank & Stock and Stock Overview for the same day
expected: Same day (20 Oct 2026): a commodity's capacity, tank count and fill are the same on both pages
actual: PFAD: Tank & Stock '2 of 3 tanks, 33.3%, 300 / 900 t' vs Stock Overview 'PFAD 300 / 460 t, 65.2%, 2 tanks'. Refined: card capacities sum to 12,270 t vs 11,020 t. Empty tank T.16 (440 t, last lab PFAD) is PFAD on Tank & Stock but 'Other' on Stock Overview (Other = T.01+T.07+T.16 = 1,690 t)
evidence: get_page_text on / and /management?view=commodity; API /portfolio/stock classes pfad capacityKg 460000 tanks 2, other 1690000 tanks 3; /sites/bekasi/live/tanks T16 productName '' oilFamily PFAD

title: QC pages render with data

actual: Overview: 11 tanks logged, 4 retest due, 175 inbound passed, 1 rejected, 5 attention items; Vessel 1 ticket 12 palka samples; Truck 175 sampled 174 pass 1 rejected; Refinery 20 Oct 2026 feed T.12 CPO FFA 3.983 -> RPO/RBDPO; Movements 0 rows (no seed data)
evidence: get_page_text per page; read_console_messages onlyErrors: no new errors

title: Oil in and out with no data shows a readable empty state

actual: Page text reads 'Counts follow the date range above. The sheet spans .' (period is empty) above zero counts

title: Utility pages render

actual: All six render; overview 'Boiler days logged 0 / 1', effluent '0 of 1 days in this range have a WWTP log'
evidence: get_page_text per page; no console errors

actual: Summary table with Refinery 500/150, Fractionation 400/500 rows showing '-'; /daily-production/refinery-500 renders its table

title: Ops analytics renders

actual: Period 22 Jul – 20 Oct 2026, tank list T.01..Bak Curah CPO Depan, 2.09 m average level, 36.8 °C average temp, chart

title: Unknown URL shows a not-found page
expected: A 'page not found' message inside the app shell with a way back
actual: Completely blank page (no shell, no message); console warning 'No routes matched location "/this-page-does-not-exist"'
evidence: navigate http://localhost:5176/this-page-does-not-exist; get_page_text body empty; read_console_messages warn. App.tsx has no path="*" route (Routes lines 72-152)

title: Master Commodities list and Edit limits dialog
expected: List per site with limit counts and aliases; Edit limits opens the editor
actual: Site Bekasi; CPO 6 limits, OLEIN 7, PFAD 3, RPO 9, RPS 6, others 'No limits'; PMF editor opened with 'No limits yet' and Add limit
evidence: get_page_text on /master/commodities

title: Commodity spec editor validation
expected: Empty limit, non-number limit, duplicate FFA Max, and FFA Min above Max are each refused with a message; nothing saved
actual: 'Enter a number for every limit.' (empty and 'abc'); 'A parameter can have one Max and one Min.'; 'A Min is above the Max for the same parameter.'; Cancel; DB quality_rules for bekasi/pmf = 0 rows
evidence: find role=alert after each Save; network: 4x PUT /master/commodities/pmf/specs?siteId=bekasi -> 400; psql count 0

title: Tank gauging Daily rounds validation
expected: Round time 25:00 and tolerance 0 are refused with a message
actual: 'Enter at least one time as HH:MM, separated by commas' and 'The tolerance must be between 1 and 240 minutes' (site QA FT Site)
evidence: get_page_text on /master/tank-gauging; network PUT /tank-gauging/sites/qa-ft-site/settings -> 400, 400. Note: the message appears at the top of the page next to 'Poll now', not next to the Daily rounds Save button

title: Tank gauging Daily rounds with one valid and two invalid times
expected: '06:30, 99:99, noon' is refused naming the invalid entries
actual: 'Round times saved.'; stored round_times = '06:30' (99:99 and noon silently dropped)
evidence: network PUT /tank-gauging/sites/qa-ft-site/settings -> 200; psql tank_gauging_settings qa-ft-site round_times '06:30', tolerance 30. Same defect as API FT-TG-05

title: Administration and master pages render for the Administrator
expected: /admin/users, /admin/roles, /admin/site-modules, /admin/datahub, /master, /master/sites, /master/tank-farm render without console errors
actual: Users 14 (12 active, 2 inactive); Roles 15; Site modules matrix; DataHub connection panel; Sites 6; Tank farm table T.01 300,000 kg ...

actual: 'Access denied – You do not have permission to view this page.' on all three
evidence: get_page_text per page. (/admin itself shows the Administration heading with an empty menu)

actual: 'Not available for this site – This module is not switched on for the site you are viewing.'; menu shows only Stock Overview; switching back to Bekasi restores the dashboard

title: Sign out

actual: User menu > Sign out -> /login; /management -> /login
evidence: URL after click and after navigate

title: Dev-server proxy to the API
expected: http://localhost:5176/api/v1/health answers {ok:true}
actual: {"ok":true,"env":"dev"}

title: No JavaScript errors on any page
expected: read_console_messages shows no uncaught errors or React errors across the session
actual: Only resource errors that the tests caused on purpose: 5x 401 (session probe before sign-in, wrong password, probe after sign-out) and 6x 400 (the negative spec and rounds saves); one router warning for the unknown URL (FT-UI-17)
